source_summary: Vertical monochrome Chinese landscape with layered mountains, ravines, clustered dwellings, water edges, bridges, pines, shrubs, bamboo-like groves, and misty washes. Calligraphy, seals, margins, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: central_striated_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant central mountain mass rising from the middle of the painting, including its rounded summit, dark wooded crest, sweeping vertical striations, terraced mid-slope paths, and pale misty gullies. Exclude the calligraphy area and separate lower village clusters where possible.
must_preserve: arched vertical hemp-fiber texture strokes on the slopes
dark ink foliage dots along the ridge crest
soft gray wash transitions on the mountain faces
terraced horizontal path lines across the lower slope
misty pale channels separating darker ridges

motifs.name: left_misty_valley_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the left midground valley with distant triangular peaks, receding hills, a narrow pale ravine or stream path, and small vertical tree strokes on the slopes.
must_preserve: faint triangular distant peak silhouettes
thin pale winding ravine line
small clustered pine and shrub strokes
layered light-to-dark wash on receding hills
delicate contour lines on the left rocky slopes

motifs.name: right_upper_cliff_ravine
motifs.description: Isolate the upper-right cliff and ravine section, including the dark rocky shoulder at the far right, descending striated cliff face, narrow valley notch, scattered trees, and darker rock pockets at the base.
must_preserve: curving vertical cliff texture strokes
dark ink rock clusters along the right edge
small sparse tree marks in the ravine
soft gray wash suggesting mist between cliffs
jagged base rocks at the valley floor

motifs.name: mid_left_hidden_pavilion_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion or house cluster tucked among trees on the mid-left hillside, with its slanted roofs, surrounding shrubs, nearby rocks, and adjacent water or path edge.
must_preserve: angular roof geometry with dark ridge lines
thin wall outlines beneath the roofs
surrounding leaf and bamboo-like strokes
nearby pale water/path boundary
rock outlines and dark ink accents around the settlement

motifs.name: center_right_bamboo_rock_gully
motifs.description: Isolate the central-right gully with bamboo-like trees, shrubs, jagged rocks, a narrow path or bridge-like line, and the small ravine descending between slopes.
must_preserve: spiky bamboo and shrub leaf strokes
angular broken rock outlines
dark ink dots at rock bases
thin path or bridge line crossing the gully
soft wash pooling in the ravine hollow

motifs.name: lower_center_hillside_hamlet
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-center hamlet set into the hillside, including small rectangular buildings, sloped roofs, adjoining terraces, sparse trees, and the descending path through the village.
must_preserve: tiny roof ridges and eaves
rectangular wall outlines
stepped hillside terraces
thin bare tree trunks around the houses
dark ink accents defining the path and settlement edges

motifs.name: lower_right_pine_grove_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the large lower-right pine grove with tall trunks, dense needle clusters, twisting branches, and rounded foreground rocks at the base.
must_preserve: radiating pine needle clusters
long vertical trunks with varied ink weight
twisting branch linework
rounded boulder forms at the base
dense dark stippling and wash shadows under the trees

motifs.name: foreground_water_bridge_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground water bank with the low bridge or crossing, pale open water, small rocks, reeds, shrubs, and the gently curving shoreline at the bottom of the composition.
must_preserve: thin horizontal water lines
low bridge or plank crossing with dark supports
curving shoreline contour
small foreground rock clusters
reed and shrub strokes along the bank

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
